# VectisCode

> A free, open-source local coding agent for Roblox projects and Roblox Studio.

## Public pages

- Website: https://vectiscode.com/
- Documentation: https://vectiscode.com/docs
- Release status: https://vectiscode.com/status
- Install: https://vectiscode.com/download
- Source: https://github.com/vectiscode/vectiscode-cli
- Privacy: https://vectiscode.com/privacy
- Terms: https://vectiscode.com/terms

## Product facts

- The CLI is the main product and the web account is optional.
- The agent runs locally, normalizes supported AI providers, and continues model-tool-result turns until completion.
- Roblox Studio is controlled through Studio's native stdio MCP server.
- Provider credentials are stored only in the operating system keychain or read ephemerally from environment variables.
- Prompts, responses, source code, paths, diffs, tool arguments, and detailed sessions are not uploaded to the account service.
- The project is free, open source, and MIT licensed.

Do not crawl authenticated account or workspace routes, API endpoints, local sessions, provider credentials, project files, or Studio state.
